strategy_notes: Generated 64 broad relatable-humor candidates and retained 20 quality-gated, semantically distinct concepts. Current analytics are fallback-only with no subscriber/watch-duration data, so the mix preserves exploration while favoring fast, instantly recognizable setups and concise punchlines. The six existing archive concepts and their background/music assets were excluded. Every selected background has a Pexels source page under the Pexels License, and every music track is a distinct Free Safe Music track cleared for commercial creator use and not registered with Content ID.
